title: catalog.graph v1.1 (CIS → TripPlanner, AA-Booking)
description: The places and the tour graph of live AA tours as the CIS catalog read model exposes them (ADR 0007 decision 2, AA-712). Rows of the views of schema `catalog` added by CIS migration 228 over the CIS-internal schema `geo` (written by the CIS jobs place_extract / place_geocode / tour_graph_build): `components` = catalog.v_tour_component, `day_route` = catalog.v_tour_day_route, `stops` = catalog.v_tour_stop, `legs` = catalog.v_tour_leg, `nodes` = catalog.v_graph_node, `edges` = catalog.v_graph_edge, `junctions` = catalog.v_tour_junction. Consumers never read `geo` (no grant). Rules: liveness is not stored — every view joins catalog.v_tour (Master Content active, not trashed, source active), so a trashed or superseded tour disappears at once; a usable destination is geo_status <> 'suspect' and not a duplicate, and nothing on an unusable one is returned; graph views read the current build only. Identity is the catalog tour key (source_system, source_id); views keep CIS column names, each row definition gives the TripPlanner mapping. Coordinates come from catalog.v_destination (contract catalog.tour.v1.1: located_by, precision, geo_status) — show the Geoapify + OpenStreetMap attribution wherever a geoapify point is drawn. No top-k vector function in v1 (S237 decision D7). v1.1 (AA-847, CIS 253): additive — `component_embeddings` = catalog.v_component_embedding, the resolved components of live tours with their 1536-d embedding, NOT a security_barrier view so `ORDER BY embedding <=> q LIMIT k` is served by the HNSW index (hnsw.iterative_scan on pgvector >= 0.8), granted to `tripplanner` only, present only where pgvector exists; and since CIS 253 every place / graph view reads liveness from the internal catalog._live_tour (same rows, same columns as v1). Consumers must accept version 1 and 1.1. A view is not an event stream: consumers read on demand or cache by build_id / built_at. Columns may be appended (minor); removing or renaming one needs a v2 view (contracts README rule 2).

version.description: Contract version. 1.1 = this file; 1 rows are valid 1.1 rows.

component.description: One row of catalog.v_tour_component. A place of a live tour as an itinerary component: one per (source, day, place, activity). Only places resolved to a usable destination appear (unresolved, suspect and duplicate places are hidden). TripPlanner mapping (tripplanner.itinerary_components): id = component_id, source_tour_id = source_id, source_day_index = day_index; the other names are the same.

source_id.description: Catalog tour identity (catalog.v_tour.source_id = raw_tours.source_group_id), stable across re-uploads. TripPlanner: source_tour_id.

tour_id.description: Current live CIS version of the tour (catalog.v_tour.tour_id).

built_from_tour_id.description: The version the row was built from.

is_stale.description: true = built from an older version (after set-active or re-publish); the previous build keeps serving until the rebuild lands.

component_id.description: Stable uuid5 of (source_id, day, itinerary spelling, tour country, activity); survives re-atomize and re-upload.

name.description: The place as the itinerary spells it.

embedding.description: cohere-embed-v4 1536-d search_document vector (pgvector). Present where the database has pgvector (RDS); query with the same model. No top-k function in v1: `MIN(embedding <=> q)` scans every component (CIS 228, decision D7).

day_route.description: One row of catalog.v_tour_day_route. Day skeleton of a live tour. TripPlanner mapping (tripplanner.tour_day): source_tour_id = source_id.

source_id.description: Catalog tour identity (catalog.v_tour.source_id = raw_tours.source_group_id), stable across re-uploads. TripPlanner: source_tour_id.

tour_id.description: Current live CIS version of the tour (catalog.v_tour.tour_id).

built_from_tour_id.description: The version the row was built from.

is_stale.description: true = built from an older version (after set-active or re-publish); the previous build keeps serving until the rebuild lands.

overnight_place.description: Text as extracted; kept even when the destination is not usable.

overnight_destination_id.description: null while the night's place is unresolved, suspect or a duplicate.

stop.description: One row of catalog.v_tour_stop. Where the traveller is on one day of a live tour: the overnight destination, else the destination with the most places that day. Current graph build only (geo.graph_build.is_current); rows of trashed / superseded tours and rows on suspect or duplicate destinations are dropped. TripPlanner mapping (tripplanner.tour_stop): source_tour_id = source_id.

source_id.description: Catalog tour identity (catalog.v_tour.source_id = raw_tours.source_group_id), stable across re-uploads. TripPlanner: source_tour_id.

tour_id.description: Current live CIS version of the tour (catalog.v_tour.tour_id).

leg.description: One row of catalog.v_tour_leg. Every day span [day_from, day_to] (day_to > day_from) of a live tour whose first and last days have a stop — the unit an advisor can sell. A leg through a suspect / duplicate destination is dropped. Current graph build only (geo.graph_build.is_current); rows of trashed / superseded tours and rows on suspect or duplicate destinations are dropped. TripPlanner mapping (tripplanner.tour_leg): source_tour_id = source_id.

source_id.description: Catalog tour identity (catalog.v_tour.source_id = raw_tours.source_group_id), stable across re-uploads. TripPlanner: source_tour_id.

tour_id.description: Current live CIS version of the tour (catalog.v_tour.tour_id).

node.description: One row of catalog.v_graph_node. A destination at least one live tour stops at. name / country / lat / lng / located_by / precision are the destination's current values; source_ids, tour_ids (aligned, ordered by source_id) and stop_count count live tours only; activities / intensity / season come from the build. Current graph build only (geo.graph_build.is_current); rows of trashed / superseded tours and rows on suspect or duplicate destinations are dropped. TripPlanner mapping (tripplanner.tour_graph_node): tour_ids = source_ids.

located_by.description: Who placed the point. geoapify = confirmed by the geocoder: wherever it is shown, show "Powered by Geoapify" (https://www.geoapify.com/) and "© OpenStreetMap contributors" (https://www.openstreetmap.org/copyright). llm = the model's point (usually precision area). manual = admin fix. mapbox = legacy TripPlanner row not yet re-confirmed. null = never located.

precision.description: point = draw a pin; area = draw an area, not a pin (unconfirmed point); null = legacy row the CIS place pipeline has not processed yet.

edge.description: One row of catalog.v_graph_edge. Directed step A -> B between consecutive stops of live tours (days without a stop are skipped). tour_count, source_ids and tour_ids count live tours only. km = great-circle distance. Current graph build only (geo.graph_build.is_current); rows of trashed / superseded tours and rows on suspect or duplicate destinations are dropped. TripPlanner mapping (tripplanner.tour_graph_edge): tour_ids = source_ids.

junction.description: One row of catalog.v_tour_junction. Two graph nodes within the build's junction distance (default 150 km), one row per direction, kept while a live tour stops at both ends. Current graph build only (geo.graph_build.is_current); rows of trashed / superseded tours and rows on suspect or duplicate destinations are dropped. Same shape as tripplanner.tour_junction (+ build_id).

component_embedding.description: One row of catalog.v_component_embedding (CIS 253). The top-k scan object over live resolved components; usable-destination and other checks are applied by the reader after the scan (join catalog.v_destination / catalog.v_tour_component). TripPlanner mapping: id = component_id, source_tour_id = source_id. Granted to tripplanner only.

embedding.description: Cohere Embed v4 (a3_place_embed), input_type search_document; pgvector text form on the wire.
